mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.totpHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.backupHint: Enter one of your backup codes. Each one works only once.
mfa.expired: The time to enter the code has run out. Sign in again.
mfa.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.
mfa.passkeyHint: Use your passkey to confirm it's you.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: How you sign in and where your account is open.
security.linkHelp: Two-step verification and open sessions are under Security.

sessions.title: Open sessions
sessions.help: The devices where your account is signed in. Close any you don't recognise.
sessions.closeOthersMessage: {count} sessions will be closed. Those devices go back to the sign-in page on their next request.

history.title: Sign-in history
history.help: Recent sign-ins and security changes on your account.

access.title: Access
access.closeAllMessage: The user will return to the sign-in page on all their devices.
access.unavailable: No access information is available for this user.

password.tooShort: The password is too short for the company's policy.
password.tooCommon: That password is too common: choose another one.

mfaSetup.title: Turn on two-step verification
mfaSetup.bodyCompany: {company} requires a second factor to sign in. Turn it on now to continue.
mfaSetup.body: Your company requires a second factor to sign in. Turn it on now to continue.
mfaSetup.continueHint: Once it is on, enter the ERP.
mfaSetup.checkError: It is not turned on yet. Finish the setup and try again.

passkey.title: Passkeys
passkey.help: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN, with no password to type.
passkey.addHint: Give it a name so you can recognise it, then confirm in your device's prompt.
passkey.removeMessage: You will no longer be able to sign in with this passkey. Your other sessions will be closed.
passkey.here: This key belongs to this device
passkey.elsewhere: This key belongs to the web
passkey.unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
passkey.exists: This passkey is already on your account.
passkey.requiredByPolicy: You can't remove your only passkey: your company requires a second factor.
passkey.error: The passkey operation could not be completed. Please try again.
passkey.loginFailed: Could not sign in with the passkey. Try again or use your password.
passkey.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a moment.
passkey.elsewhereDesktop: Your passkey is in the desktop app. Sign in from there or use another method.
passkey.elsewhereDevice: Your passkey belongs to another device. Sign in from that device or use another method.
